title: Max makes a game
scene: Max and a friend want to be game developers. A project manager and one more dev join them to make an RPG with elves, orcs, goblins and a mage who needs mana; the gameplay is simple, players can add a mod, choose an avatar and try a flight simulator.

old_story: Max and his friend Oleh dream of becoming [[game developers|game developer]]. This year, they finally start their own small project. Max's cousin Ira joins as [[project manager]], and a classmate joins as one more [[dev]]. Together they make an [[RPG]] about a magic forest. The hero is a brave [[elf]] who fights an [[orc]] and a sneaky [[goblin]]. On the way, she meets an old [[mage]] who has no [[mana]] left. The [[gameplay]] is simple, but their friends love it. Players can even add a [[mod]] and choose their own [[avatar]]. After a month, a hundred people download the game, and Ira orders pizza for everyone.

title: Uncle's poker night
scene: Max's uncle invites friends to play poker. He tries a bluff, goes all-in and loses to a full house - a real hustler takes his money; then he talks about his trips to the casino, blackjack, gambling and a jackpot, and Grandma says he is a gambler who should play pinball instead.

old_story: Max's uncle Petro invites his friends for a [[poker]] night. They play with plastic chips and a big bowl of peanuts. Uncle Petro tries a big [[bluff]] and goes [[all-in]]. But his neighbor calmly shows a [[full house]]. "You're a real [[hustler]]!" Uncle Petro laughs and hands over all his chips. Then he tells long stories about a [[casino]] trip many years ago. He played [[blackjack]] all night and lost everything. "[[Gambling|gambling]] is not for me anymore," he says. "I never won a [[jackpot]], not once." Grandma shakes her head. "You're a [[gambler]], Petro. Play [[pinball]] instead!"

title: Max goes viral
scene: Max posts a funny video of his cat. It becomes a meme and a trend: people share it on their timeline, tag friends and tweet about it, the hype grows, and a brand offers him a giveaway; then he posts a how-to with a kitchen hack and a playlist for cat lovers.

old_story: Max films a funny [[video]] of his cat, Bublyk. He drags the clip onto the [[timeline]] and adds music. The next day, it is a [[meme]]. Soon it is a [[trend]] in the whole city. People add a [[tag]] with the cat's name. His classmate writes a [[tweet]] about it. The [[hype]] grows every day. A pet shop offers a [[giveaway]] for his fans. Then Max posts a [[how-to]] about a kitchen [[hack]] for cat owners. He also makes a [[playlist]] of songs for cat lovers. Bublyk does not care. He just sleeps on the keyboard.

title: Meeting a superstar
scene: Sofia is a finalist in a TV talent show, and a talent scout from showbiz notices her. Backstage she meets a superstar - a rich playboy - with a bodyguard; VIP guests talk about glamour, the paparazzi take photos, and fans from the fan club ask for an autograph.

old_story: Sofia is a [[finalist]] in a TV [[talent show]]. After her song, a talent [[scout]] from [[showbiz]] gives her a card. Backstage, she meets a famous [[superstar]]. He is a rich [[playboy]] with a big [[bodyguard]]. [[VIP]] guests talk about [[glamour]] and fast cars. Outside, the [[paparazzi]] take hundreds of photos. Then girls from her school [[fan club]] run to Sofia. They ask for her [[autograph]], not his!

title: A day at the zoo
scene: Anna takes Taras to the zoo. They see a tiger, a gorilla, an orangutan, a panda and a zebra, a leopard on a branch, a crocodile, a big python, flamingos and lemurs; a guide explains each animal's habitat, and they buy hot dogs at the snack bar.

old_story: On Saturday, Anna takes her little brother Taras to the zoo. First, they see a big [[tiger]] and a quiet [[gorilla]]. A mother [[orangutan]] holds her baby. The [[panda]] eats bamboo, and a [[zebra]] runs in the sun. A [[leopard]] sleeps on a high branch. In the river, a [[crocodile]] opens its huge mouth. Taras hides behind Anna when he sees the [[python]]. Next, they watch pink [[flamingos|flamingo]] and funny [[lemurs|lemur]]. A guide explains each animal's natural [[habitat]]. At the end, they are very hungry. They buy hot dogs at the [[snack bar]].
